stories.headline: Chinese teachers publicly shamed on stage for students’ low test scores, sparking outrage

opening: An impoverished county in southwestern China issued an apology for arranging its primary and junior secondary school teachers on stage to pose for photos alongside prominent characters depicting humiliation due to their students’ low test scores.
The images, which went viral on social media, sparked widespread public condemnation.
body: They were captured at an internal meeting organised by the Leibo County Education Bureau in Sichuan province in late August, as reported by Zhengzai News.

stories.title: Cats and mind-full mechanics: what happens when quantum physics meets the brain
stories.summary: Cats are wonderful gymnasts. Their ability to land on their feet – even when dropped upside-down – caught the attention of two of the nineteenth century’s greatest mathematical physicists, Sir George Gabriel Stokes and James Clerk Maxwell.
